top_signals.title: Israel signs $3.5 billion air defense deal with Greece
top_signals.summary: Israel and Greece signed a €3 billion ($3.5 billion) defense deal on Monday under which Israel will build a multi-layered air defense system for Greece.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin begins volatile monthly close as US bond yields eye new 20-year high
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin price action saw sharp moves within its local range as US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent addressed US bond yields.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Colombia Plans $11 Billion Extra Borrowing This Year, Debt Swaps
top_signals.summary: Colombia’s incoming administration plans to raise about $11 billion and carry out debt swaps to manage its 2026 financing needs, public credit director Cesar Arias told market makers, according to people who attended the meeting.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
